python - <<'PY'
import warnings
from marshmallow import Schema, fields, missing, ValidationError
from marshmallow.warnings import RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning
from marshmallow_jsonschema import JSONSchema

with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('error', RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning)
    for cls in (fields.Field, fields.Raw):
        field = cls(load_default=lambda: 3, dump_default=lambda: 4)
        assert field.deserialize(missing) == 3
        assert field.serialize('x', {}) == 4
        assert field.deserialize(5) == 5
        assert field.serialize('x', {'x': 6}) == 6
        assert field.metadata == {}
        assert 'dump_default=' in repr(field) and 'load_default=' in repr(field)
        assert cls(load_default=None).deserialize(None) is None
        try:
            cls(required=True, load_default=0)
        except ValueError as exc:
            assert 'load_default' in str(exc)
        else:
            raise AssertionError('required and load_default accepted')
    class Child(Schema):
        value = fields.Int()
    nested = fields.Nested(Child, load_default={'value': 1}, dump_default={'value': 2})
    assert nested.deserialize(missing) == {'value': 1}
    assert nested.serialize('child', {}) == {'value': 2}
    assert nested.deserialize({'value': '3'}) == {'value': 3}
    constant = fields.Constant(7, load_default=8, dump_default=9)
    assert constant.deserialize(missing) == 7
    assert constant.deserialize(8) == 7
    assert constant.serialize('x', {}) == 7
    class Parent(Schema):
        child = nested
        raw = fields.Raw(load_default=10, dump_default=11)
        constant = constant
        callable_default = fields.Int(dump_default=lambda: 99)
    schema = JSONSchema().dump(Parent())['definitions']['Parent']['properties']
    assert schema['raw']['default'] == 11
    assert schema['child']['default'] == {'value': 2}
    assert schema['constant']['default'] == 7
    assert 'default' not in schema['callable_default']
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter('always', RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning)
    field = fields.Field(default=1, missing=2)
    assert field.default == field.dump_default == 1
    assert field.missing == field.load_default == 2
    field.default = 3
    field.missing = 4
    assert field.serialize('x', {}) == 3 and field.deserialize(missing) == 4
    assert len(caught) == 6
print('New default API, legacy aliases, and warning-free schema generation checks passed.')
